notes:
A person who writes ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧ (poetry). Used for both modern and classical poets, Japanese and foreign.

ETYMOLOGY:
Compound of ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧ (poetry) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person).

RELATED LITERARY OCCUPATIONS:
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer, author (general)
- ⟦{小説家|しょうせつか}→小説家：03070_shousetsuka⟧: novelist
- ⟦{歌人|かじん}→歌人：20522_kajin⟧: waka poet (traditional 31-syllable Japanese poetry)
- ⟦{俳人|はいじん}→俳人：09569_haijin⟧: haiku poet
- ⟦{劇作家|げきさっか}→劇作家：28064_gekisakka⟧: playwright

NOTE ON JAPANESE POETRY TYPES:
⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧ specifically refers to modern free verse or Western-style poetry. Traditional Japanese poetry forms have their own terms: ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧ (waka), ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧ (haiku), ⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧ (tanka). So a {詩人|しじん} is distinct from a ⟦{歌人|かじん}→歌人：20522_kajin⟧ or ⟦{俳人|はいじん}→俳人：09569_haijin⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {詩人|しじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a poet
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{詩人|しじん}: a famous poet
